printers.py.summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive Android UI automation page object for HP Smart app printer management. It extends SmartFlow and implements the Page Object Model pattern with extensive printer discovery, connection, and setup flows. Key features include Android version-specific handling for UI differences, multiple printer connection types (WiFi, WiFi Direct, Ethernet, OOBE, Remote), robust error handling with retry mechanisms, permission management flows for location, Bluetooth, and nearby devices, extensive verification methods, timeout-based waiting strategies, scrolling and swipe gestures for list navigation, popup and dialog handling throughout printer setup workflows, search functionality with keyword-based and IP-based printer discovery, and setup wizard flows with multi-step navigation. The class demonstrates enterprise-grade test automation with comprehensive coverage of printer management scenarios including edge cases, first-time user experiences, and platform-specific behaviors.
